stem: Which drug combination corresponds to Trikafta?
explanation: Elexacaftor + tezacaftor + ivacaftor is the correct combination for Trikafta.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

rationale: Trikafta is the triple-combination cystic fibrosis modulator made up of two correctors, elexacaftor and tezacaftor, plus the potentiator ivacaftor.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because ivacaftor alone is Kalydeco, not Trikafta.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because lumacaftor + ivacaftor is Orkambi, not Trikafta.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because tezacaftor + ivacaftor is Symdeko, not Trikafta.
optionExplanations.D: Correct because Trikafta contains elexacaftor, tezacaftor, and ivacaftor.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because gene therapy is not part of the Trikafta combination.
